title: 第24章 墙头草第25章 天地灵珠
slug: 玄幻我有机甲鬼才愿意去修仙
content_zh:
“老八，是你？哼，柳家何时有如此魄力了，给本大爷送10万两。”
王继昌看是老八，差点扭头就走。
老八是谁，柳家的家奴罢了，有什么资格跟他坐在一桌上。
就是柳无无亲自来了，他也不会多看几眼。
更别提是他了。
“是，柳家以前是不济，可如今不一样了。”
老八本来就不愿意来，现在又看他摆出盛气凌人的样子，差点就撸起袖子。
“王公子请坐。”
王继昌也不客气，大马金刀地坐下，顺手拿起满杯的酒杯，瞥了一眼老八，“说吧，找我干什么？”
“也没别的事情，就想和王公子叙叙旧。”
老八拍了拍手，示意伙计上菜。
“得了，是那个新来的让你来的吧，他倒是好手笔，一开口就是10万两。”
王继昌也不是什么好鸟，在家里是有地位，可真要继承他爹的位子，不知何年马月才能轮到他。
所以，享乐成了他的唯一人生信条。
可惜，兜里时常见底的他也没什么能力去赚钱。
不然，也不会避开家人，来赴约了。
老八缓缓坐下，拿起酒壶给自己满了一杯，“王公子，你到底是想继续待在王家，还是.....”
“还是？我好歹是王家人，你觉得我会背叛家族？”
王继昌冷冷地笑了笑，有人送他十万两，不收那才是傻子，可区区十万两让他出卖家族，那就真是太可笑了。
他抿了一口酒，感觉就很特殊，便又尝了一口，眉头一紧。

“这酒是天月楼珍藏的百月酒，连我爹去了都只能得到一杯，你们却能......”
他边说边看向老八手里的酒壶。
酒壶上有天月楼三个字。
绝对错不了，这酒确实是百月酒，当初白家来人，我爹腆着老脸才买到半壶。
这人到底是什么来头，居然能在这么短时间跟天月楼扯上关系。
老八伸出三根手指，看到伙计端菜上来，拿着酒杯只是闻了闻酒香便放下来。
一口酒居然要十两银子，他可没那福分。
王继昌现在也没兴趣吃，毕竟来这里谈事情，要喝酒也不是这里。
等人走后，便拿起酒壶起身给老八倒酒，这换了以前，只有别人巴结他，何时他给人敬过酒。
“老八，出卖王家我可做不到。”
老八鄙夷地看了他一眼，心想你什么货色全城都清楚，你跟我说什么不会出卖王家。
“门主也不要求什么，只需要王公子在必要时派人来知会一声王家要做什么就可以。”
“10万两就为了一句话，会不会太多了？”
王继昌眉头一挑，淡淡的说道。
content_en:
"Old man, is that you? Humph, when did the Liu family have the courage to give me 100,000 taels?"
When Wang Jichang saw that it was Lao Ba, he almost turned around and left.
Who is Lao Ba? He is just a slave of the Liu family. What qualifications do he have to sit at the same table with him?
Even if Liu Wuwu came in person, he wouldn't look at it more.
Let alone him.
"Yes, the Liu family was in trouble before, but it's different now."
Lao Ba was not willing to come in the first place, but now seeing him acting domineering, he almost rolled up his sleeves.
"Master Wang, please sit down."
Wang Jichang was not polite either. He sat down calmly, picked up the full wine glass and glanced at Lao Ba, "Tell me, what are you doing with me?"
"I don't have anything else to do, I just want to catch up with the prince."
Lao Ba clapped his hands and signaled the waiter to serve the food.
"Come on, it's the new guy who asked you to come. He's really good at it. He gave me 100,000 taels as soon as he opened his mouth."
Wang Jichang is not a good person either. He has status in the family, but if he really wants to inherit his father's position, he doesn't know when it will be his turn.
Therefore, enjoyment became his only life creed.
Unfortunately, he often has too much money in his pocket and has no ability to make money.
Otherwise, I wouldn’t have avoided my family and come to the appointment.
Lao Ba slowly sat down, picked up the wine bottle and filled himself a glass, "Master Wang, do you want to continue to stay in the Wang family, or..."
"Still? I am a member of the Wang family after all. Do you think I will betray the family?"
Wang Jichang smiled coldly. Someone gave him one hundred thousand taels. He would be a fool if he didn't accept it. But asking him to betray his family for just one hundred thousand taels would be really ridiculous.
He took a sip of the wine and it felt very special, so he took another sip and frowned.
"This wine is the Baiyue Wine treasured by Tianyue Tower. Even my father can only get one cup when he goes there, but you can..."
As he spoke, he looked at the wine bottle in Lao Ba's hand.
There are three characters on the wine pot: Tianyuelou.
There is absolutely no mistake, this wine is indeed Baiyue wine. When the Bai family came, my father was so shy that he only bought half a bottle.
Who is this person? How could he be associated with Tianyue Tower in such a short period of time.
Lao Ba stretched out three fingers and saw the waiter bringing the food. He held the wine glass and just smelled the aroma of the wine before putting it down.
A drink of wine actually costs ten taels of silver. He is not that lucky.
Wang Jichang is not interested in eating now. After all, this is not the place to talk and drink.
After the people left, he picked up the jug and stood up to pour wine for Lao Ba. Before, he only had others to fawn over him, and he had never toasted anyone.
"Baby, I can't betray the Wang family."
Lao Ba glanced at him with disdain, thinking that the whole city knew what you were, and you told me that you wouldn't betray the Wang family.
"The master doesn't ask for anything. He only needs the prince to send someone to inform the Wang family of what they want to do when necessary."
"100,000 taels just for one sentence, isn't it too much?"
Wang Jichang raised his eyebrows and said calmly.
